label: Bounded debuggers / 有界调试观察

tools.label: CDB
tools.description: Windows debugger: one breakpoint, registers and fixed-length memory / Windows 断点、寄存器与定长内存
tools.guide: Inspect file architecture and dependencies first. Match CDB architecture to the imported executable. Load security_capabilities for providerId debugger, then use debugger/run through an approved validation plan. Parameters select engine cdb, breakpoint, optional argv and fixed-length memory. Host debugging uses Host permissions. Detection does not authorize execution or prove that the requested observation is available.

tools.label: GDB/MI
tools.description: Managed Linux debugger: one breakpoint, registers and fixed-length memory / 托管 Linux 断点、寄存器与定长内存
tools.guide: Inspect file architecture and dependencies first. The debugger provider accepts imported ELF executables in managed Linux Docker, not an external container. Load security_capabilities for providerId debugger, then use debugger/run through an approved validation plan. Parameters select engine gdb, breakpoint, optional argv and fixed-length memory. Fork children remain under debugger control. Detection does not authorize execution or prove that the requested observation is available.
